clip.summary: A red bicycle is parked against a brick wall on a wet street at night. The pavement displays colorful reflections of neon signs from a nearby shop, illuminated by the ambient glow of city lights.
clip.style: Nighttime urban atmosphere with neon reflections
clip.prompt: A red bicycle is parked against a brick wall on a wet street at night, with the colorful reflections of neon signs from a nearby shop visible on the pavement. The scene is quiet and still, illuminated by the ambient glow of the city lights.
clip.basis: vision model, from the shot descriptions

vision.note: Scene descriptions and prompts are a vision model's reading of the keyframes, not ground truth. The reconstructed prompt is a NEW prompt meant to produce a similar clip; it is not the prompt or the model that made this video, which cannot be recovered from the pictures.

camera_measured: slow push-in / zoom in (a lens zoom and moving the camera look the same in 2D)

vision.text: A red bicycle is parked against a brick wall on a wet street at night, with the colorful reflections of neon signs from a nearby shop visible on the pavement. The scene is quiet and still, illuminated by the ambient glow of the city lights.
vision.action: The bicycle remains stationary throughout the shot, leaning against the wall while the camera slowly pushes in towards it.
vision.setting: An urban street at night, outside a shop with a blue sign.
vision.lighting: mixed artificial light from street lamps and neon signs, creating strong reflections
vision.prompt: A static shot of a red bicycle parked against a dark brick wall on a wet city street at night. In the background, a shop with a blue sign and glowing neon lights is visible, casting colorful reflections onto the wet pavement. The camera performs a slow, subtle push-in towards the bicycle. The mood is atmospheric and quiet, lit by the mix of streetlights and neon glow.
